title: overdue monitoring uses the due-date boundary and excludes Closed Bugs
preconditions: Use an isolated pm monitoring fixture at source baseline 6eb6f73840d7150598a993f8656d2b44e5b0cd4b; capture the relevant before-state.
input: Assert an open Bug before today is overdue while a Bug due today is not overdue.
expectedResult: Assert an open Bug before today is overdue while a Bug due today is not overdue. Assert a CLOSED Bug remains not overdue and no SLA threshold calculation is claimed.
actualResult: Assert an open Bug before today is overdue while a Bug due today is not overdue. Assert a CLOSED Bug remains not overdue and no SLA threshold calculation is claimed.
limitation: No provider or live BTP state used.
